cadence_decision.why_withdrawn: The frozen limitation is a conjunction: empty right detector frame AND non-unit cadence. A prospective schedule controls which frames are sampled but cannot control whether the right detector frame is empty, which physics determines. An entity dissolving before the horizon produces an empty right frame at non-unit cadence, so under any hypothesis where dissolution is common a large fraction of worlds would be globally rejected rather than classified, biasing the primary estimand toward the surviving outcome class. G11 was therefore not demonstrated.

feasibility_architecture.no_replacement_rule: enrollment fixed at declaration; a world that fails is recorded, counted in attrition and never replaced; the denominator is always the enrolled set
feasibility_architecture.attrition_accounting: every enrolled world resolves to exactly one terminal state; attrition is a complete partition of the enrolled set with pre-window and post-window failures separated; a family whose attrition cannot be partitioned is FEASIBILITY_INVALID
feasibility_architecture.eligibility: declared before data, computed from pre-window state only; post-window information may never enter eligibility

corrections_to_part_two.C-1: H_X (mutual exclusivity of persistence and turnover) is falsified by the same aggregate summary Part II cited: eleven BOUNDED_ACTIVE_TURNOVER_CANDIDATE classifications exhibited both properties.
corrections_to_part_two.C-2: The only defence of H_X is a transient/incoherent relabelling that the frozen autopsy explicitly forbids. Part II credited the classifier's non-candidate counts while discounting its candidate counts. Withdrawn as self-flattery.
corrections_to_part_two.C-3: The compelled failure was a replication-density failure with initial-condition-class dependence (0/8 laws met the two-of-four minimum in both IC classes), not a structural exclusivity result. Part II omitted this line entirely.
corrections_to_part_two.C-4: Absence of TRACKING_UNRESOLVED does not refute a SPLIT/LOST characterization; the atlas has no SPLIT/LOST columns and is silent, not contradictory.
corrections_to_part_two.C-5: What survives: the negative half (no instrumentation failure; byte-identical replay) and Correction 2 (the mechanism is formally unknown because the autopsy returned AUDIT_INVALID).
corrections_to_part_two.C-6: Part I section 4.4 deviation declared rather than edited; Part I prescribes ARCHITECTURE_REVISE for exactly this.
